itemSize.doc: Scalars per item: 1 = scalars, 3 = vector3, 6 = symmetric tensor

size.doc: Raw number of scalars, count() * itemSize()

empty.doc: True when there are no scalars

item.doc: The i-th item, as a copy of itemSize consecutive scalars

scalar.doc: The i-th scalar of an itemSize == 1 serie (throws otherwise)

scalars.doc: The scalars of an itemSize == 1 serie (throws otherwise)

raw.doc: The flat buffer, whatever the itemSize

append.doc: Append the items of another serie; returns this one, so calls chain

map.doc: A new serie of f applied to each scalar (itemSize 1 only)

reduce.doc: Fold f over the scalars from init (itemSize 1 only)

forEach.doc: Call f once per scalar (itemSize 1 only)
